title: Encrypted Admin Pathway: Operator Proof Matrix and Onboarding Criteria for Private Deploy
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Purpose: Define product requirements, scope decisions, and acceptance criteria for the Operator Onboarding flow and encrypted admin pathways for Private/VPC deployments. Scope includes SSO/SAML federation requirements, RBAC role mapping and least-privilege templates for operators, audit log retention and tamper-evidence expectations, and KMS/HSM key custody options (customer-managed or Redwood-hosted). Out of scope: on-prem installer packaging changes, offline air-gapped hardware procurement, and broader tenant onboarding UI work (separate EPIC).
decision_summary: Federation model: support SAML 2.0 IdP with optional SCIM for group sync; SP-initiated and IdP-initiated flows required.

RBAC: provide a default operator role bundle (Operator-ReadOnly, Operator-Admin, Operator-KeyCustodian) and allow custom role templates; RBAC enforcement must be consistent across Console and Private control plane APIs.
KMS: support both externally-provided customer KMS (BYOK) with HSM-backed keys and Redwood-managed KMS with HSM protection; key wrapping and dual-signature for rotation events required for BYOK.

Audit: append-only, signed audit stream exported to customer-defined S3/GCS or SIEM with 90-day default retention and configurable long-term export; tamper-evidence via event hashes and rotation chain.
Operator access model: ephemeral operator sessions using short-lived service tokens issued via SAML assertion exchange; require MFA at IdP for operator roles in high-sensitivity tenants.
scope_clarifications: We will not implement SCIM push provisioning in the first cut; initial delivery includes group membership mapping via SAML attribute mapping and manual mapping UI.
HSM integration will support industry-standard PKCS#11 and cloud HSM APIs; vendor-specific drivers beyond PKCS#11 are out of scope for MVP.
Encrypted admin pathway refers to the chain of custody for administrative actions affecting key material and operator role changes only; general app admin flows remain under console-2025.10 scope.
Cross-tenant operator delegation (i.e., operator with access across multiple customers) is explicitly disallowed in this scope.
acceptance_criteria: SSO/SAML: Able to configure at least one SAML IdP and complete an SP-initiated login end-to-end in staging with a customer test IdP; SAML metadata import and certificate rotation tested.
RBAC: Create, edit, and assign the three default operator roles; changes must be enforced on the Private control plane API and reflected in Console within 30s under normal load.

Audit logs: Administrative events (role changes, key rotations, operator login events, KMS policy updates) are recorded with immutable event IDs, signed-hash chain, and exportable to S3/GCS; tamper-check script returns status OK/FAIL in automated test harness.
KMS/HSM: Customer-supplied KMS keys can be imported and used for data key encryption; simulated key rotation triggers workload and produces signed rotation events in audit logs.

Operator onboarding: Operator invites (tokenized) delivered and redeemable; onboarding flow enforces role mapping and results in a session token scoped to assigned roles with TTL <= 15 minutes for sensitive roles.
Telemetry & monitoring: New metrics for operator sessions, key-usage count, and failed privilege elevation attempts are visible in runtime-telemetry dashboard with 1m granularity.
Security tests: Penetration test scenarios for SAML assertion replay, RBAC bypass attempts, and KMS API misuse are executed with zero high-severity regressions in staging before sign-off.
signoff_checklist: PM signoff: PRD reviewed and clarified (Ava Martinez).
Design signoff: UI flows for mapping SAML attributes and manual group mapping approved (Lead Designer to confirm).
Engineering signoff: ENG owners confirm implementation plan, infra quota, and estimated risk (Rajat Singh + ENG-41204).
Security signoff: Threat model reviewed, and mitigations accepted by Security team with pentest schedule (security@redwood).
Compliance signoff: Audit export and retention plan accepted by Compliance owner for target regions (EU/US).
Customer validation: Verify flow with pilot customer (acme-corp) using BYOK test key in staging and pass onboarding checklist.
Operational runbook: Operator onboarding runbook and emergency key-rotation rollback steps documented in Confluence with runbook link added to ticket.
Release gating: Feature toggle and canary plan documented; GA gated on 2-week canary with zero P1 incidents.
test_scenarios: IdP certificate rotation: simulate IdP certificate change and verify uninterrupted operator login after metadata update.
Key rotation failure: simulate failed KMS rotation and verify automated rollback and alerting works; audit entry created for failure reason.
Tamper-evidence verification: modify an archived audit chunk and confirm tamper-check script flags mismatch.
RBAC regression: attempt API actions outside of assigned roles and confirm 403 responses and audit entries recorded.
rollout_notes: Beta: opt-in for Private customers with dedicated onboarding assistance; provide a migration checklist for existing operator accounts.
Canary: enable for 5 internal tenants and 2 pilot customers for 2 weeks; monitor operator session SLOs and audit export success rates.
GA: unlock to all paying private-deploy tenants after compliance and pentest signoffs.
